name: GATE Overflow Test Series 2024 | Mix Subjects | Test 2

question.text:
In the sequential circuit shown below, if the initial value of the output $Q_1Q_0$ is $11,$ what are the next four values of $Q_1Q_0?$

  1. $11,01,10,00$
  2. $10,11,01,00$
  3. $10,00,01,11$
  4. $11,10,01,00$

What is the best case complexity in building a min-heap?

  1. $\Theta(n\log n)$
  2. $\Theta(n^2)$
  3. $O(\log n)$
  4. $O(n)$
There are $2^{2^3} = 256$ boolean functions of three variables. How many of these $3$-input Boolean functions depend on all three variables?
The minimum number of 2-to-4 line decoders with an enable input needed to construct a 4-to-16 line decoder without using any other logic gates is _____

What will be the output of the following C code?

#include<stdio.h> 
int main()
{
    int array[4] = {1, 2, 3, 4};
    printf("%d\n", *array + array[0]
        + *array+1 + array[array[1]]);
}

Which of the following statements is/are TRUE? (Mark all the appropriate choices)

  1. The XOR function is the mathematical equivalent of binary addition
  2. The AND function is the mathematical equivalent of binary multiplication
  3. The AND function is the mathematical equivalent of binary addition
  4. The OR function is the mathematical equivalent of binary addition

In an SR latch made by cross-coupling two NOR gates, both $S$ and $R$ inputs are set to $1$, and then both are again set to $0$ after the output is stabilized. This will result in the output

  1. No change
  2. $Q = 1, Q' = 0$
  3. $Q = 0, Q' = 1$
  4. Indeterminate state

If the minimum number of two-input NAND gates required to design a $1$-bit full adder is denoted by $M$ and the minimum number of two-input NOR gates required for the same is denoted by $N$, then $M+N = $ _______

Which of the following gates are represented by the below two logic circuits?

  1. NAND, NOR
  2. AND, OR
  3. XOR, XNOR
  4. NOR, NAND

Consider a $5$ stage MIPS Pipeline with the following features:

  • For a non-pipeline implementation, ALU operations and branches take $3$ cycles while memory operations take $5$ cycles and clock rate is $3$ GHz
  • Relative frequencies of ALU operations, branches and memory operations are $55\%, 15\%$ and $30\%.$
  • In the pipeline due to clock skew and setup time, the clock cycle time increases by $0.65$ ns.

Calculate the estimated speedup (rounded to $2$ decimal points).

What does the following piece of code do?

struct Tree
{
    int data;
    struct Tree* left;
    struct Tree* right;
};
void func(struct Tree* root)
{
    print("%d", root-> data); 
​    ​​​func(root-> left);
    func(root-> right);
}
  1. Preorder traversal
  2. Inorder traversal
  3. Postorder traversal
  4. Level order traversal

If the values printed by the following C code are $a$ and $b,$ $a + b =$ _____

#include<stdio.h> 
int main()
{
    int array[5] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    int *p = array;
    printf("%ld\t%ld", p - array, p - (int*)&array);
}
The number of distinct binary search trees of maximum height $3$ (counted from $0)$ possible with $5$ elements is _______

Which of the following is/are TRUE regarding IEEE-$754$ representation? (Mark all the appropriate choices)

  1. IEEE-$754$ single precision representation allows only normalized numbers
  2. The range of numbers representable by IEEE-$754$ double precision representation is double that of IEEE-$754$ single precision representation
  3. IEEE-$754$ double precision representation allows precise representation of any $32$ bit integer value
  4. IEEE-$754$ representation has multiple representations possible for $0$
If a simple graph $G$ has $10$ vertices and $11$ edges, the number of edges in the complement of $G$ will be _______

A device with transfer rate of $25$ KB/sec is connected to a CPU. Data is transferred byte-wise and the interrupt overhead is $12$ microseconds. The byte transfer time between the device interface register and CPU or memory is negligible. What is the minimum performance gain of operating device under interrupt driven mode over operating it under program-controlled mode?

In most cases, the product of two $n-bit$ two's-complement numbers requires
fewer than $2n$ bits. In fact, there is only one case in which $2n$ bits are needed. For $n = 4,$ let this happen for the product of $p$ and $q.$ Then, $p \times q =$ _____
For the input $A = 11$ and $B = 10,$ the value of $F_1 \oplus F_2 \oplus F_3 = $ ($\oplus$ being the XOR operations)
The number of clock pulses needed to change the contents of a $6-$bit up counter from $100101$ to $000101$ is _____
The number of distinct binary trees possible with $6$ elements with just one element being repeated is ______

A switch-tail ring counter is made using a single $T$ flip flop. The resulting circuit is equivalent to:

  1. SR flip flop
  2. JK flip flop
  3. T flip flop
  4. None of the above

The following JK flip flop circuit is initially set and then clocked for $4$ clock pulses. The output sequence will be ________

  1. $0100$
  2. $1010$
  3. $0110$
  4. $0101$

Consider a 4 bit Johnson counter with an initial decimal value of $1$. The counting sequence of this counter is:

  1. $1, 3, 15, 14, 12, 8, 7, 0$
  2. $1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15$
  3. $1, 0, 8, 12, 14, 15, 7, 3$
  4. $1, 7, 3, 0, 8, 12, 14, 15$

Which of the following is guaranteed to be a complete binary tree? (Mark all the appropriate choices)

  1. A tree with every node having exactly zero or two children
  2. A binary tree, which is completely filled, with the possible exception of the bottom level, which is filled from right to left
  3. A binary tree, which is completely filled, with the possible exception of the bottom level, which is filled from left to right
  4. A binary heap

The following circuit implements a two-input OR gate using two 2-1 multiplexers.



What are the values of $X_1,X_2$ and $X_3?$

  1. $X_1=B,X_2=1,X_3=1$
  2. $X_1=A,X_2=0,X_3=A$
  3. $X_1=A,X_2=B,X_3=1$
  4. $X_1=B,X_2=0,X_3=0$

Consider the following array of elements being sorted by merge sort. The sum of all the elements to which $13$ gets compared is _____
$$14\; 13\; 24\; 56\; 87\; 98\; 4\; 65$$

For the below function, arr is pointing to an array of $len$ elements. The complexity of the function is

void func(int * arr, int len)
 {
     if(len == 0)
         return;
     printf("%d ", arr[0]);
     func(arr+1, len-1);
 }
  1. $O(n)$
  2. $\Theta( n^2)$
  3. $O(1)$
  4. $\Theta(n \log n)$

We have a RISC processor with register-register arithmetic instructions that have the format $R_1\leftarrow R_2\; op\; R_3.$ The pipeline of these instructions runs with a $3$ GHz clock with the following stages: Instruction fetch $= 1$ clock, instruction decode $= 2$ clocks, fetch operands $= 1$ clock, execute $= 3$ clocks and store results $= 2$ clocks. What rate(in MIPS) can we execute register-register instructions that have no data dependencies with other instructions?
How many cascaded mod-$8$ counters are required to divide a clock frequency by $32768?$
A Mod-$10$ ripple counter is cascaded with Mod-$15$ ripple counter. The resulting counter is a Mod-$M$ counter with $N$ flip-flops. The value of $2*M+3*N$ is _____
